tokens.name: surface-crust
tokens.usage: Deepest layer: the bar strip, lock-screen backdrop, terminal tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Base: desktop, window and terminal background. Dusk #171826 / Dawn #F7F3F0, from the brief.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels above base: launcher, notification cards, control center, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Overlays above panels: menus, tooltips, active tab, hovered row.

tokens.name: highlight-low
tokens.usage: Faintest highlight: cursor line, zebra rows.

tokens.name: highlight-med
tokens.usage: Selection background, paired with fg (7.2:1 / 9.9:1). Dusk uses Deep Indigo, Dawn uses the Color Hunt lavender #DCD6F7.

tokens.name: highlight-high
tokens.usage: Strong highlight: window borders, cursor block, inactive focus outlines.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only, never the sole affordance.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark. 14.5:1 on Dusk, 12.6:1 on Dawn.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, inactive tabs, punctuation, sub-brand descriptors. 8.4:1 / 5.3:1.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis text: code comments, placeholders, disabled labels. 4.9:1 / 4.6:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The symbol color, focus rings, active workspace indicator, primary buttons. 7.3:1 on Dusk, 7.9:1 on Dawn.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Second layer of the two-tone mark only. 1.9:1 on Dawn: never text or a lone icon there.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (7.3:1 / 7.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Coral. One tiny accent at most: an unread dot, a recording indicator. Never text on Dawn (1.8:1), never dominant.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Terminal red (1/9). Errors, deletions, builtins. 7.5:1 / 5.1:1.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Terminal green (2/10). Success, additions, functions. 10.6:1 / 5.2:1.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal yellow (3/11). Warnings, strings. 11.7:1 / 5.2:1.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal blue (4/12). Info, keywords, links. Dusk = Periwinkle. 7.3:1 / 6.3:1.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal magenta (5/13). Parameters, git staged, hints. 8.6:1 / 5.7:1.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal cyan (6/14). Types, object keys, git renamed. 10.3:1 / 5.2:1.

tokens.name: ansi-orange
tokens.usage: Extended orange for editors (constants, numbers). Dusk = Coral; Dawn darkened for text, 4.9:1.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error state: failed actions, critical notifications, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state: low battery, pending updates.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success state: completed jobs, connected.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: tips, background progress.

tokens.name: palette-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Raw palette swatch; prefer brand in UI.

tokens.name: palette-soft-indigo
tokens.usage: Brand secondary. Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-deep-indigo
tokens.usage: Light-theme logo color. Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-dusk
tokens.usage: Dusk background. Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-dawn
tokens.usage: Dawn background. Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-coral
tokens.usage: Coral accent. Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Dark foreground (Dawn wordmark, mono-dark). Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-ink-light
tokens.usage: Light foreground (Dusk wordmark, mono-light). Raw palette swatch.

tokens.name: palette-lavender
tokens.usage: From the source Color Hunt palette. Dawn selection; tints on light grounds.

tokens.name: palette-lilac
tokens.usage: From the source Color Hunt palette. Faint lavender wash for Dawn illustrations; never text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: 14·√φ⁴ ≈ 36.6. Greeter and lock-screen clock, welcome screens. Light, like the wordmark.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Theme applied across Hyprland, GTK, Qt and the terminal.
styles.usage: Base size. Line height φ. Default UI text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: CLI output, config values, terminal default.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 3. Hairline offsets, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 5. Gap between bar modules.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 8. Row padding; Hyprland gaps_in.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 13. Card and panel padding; Hyprland gaps_out.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 21. Space between groups in settings and control center.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 34. Page margins, section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 5. Chips, inputs, workspace pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 8. Buttons, list rows, Hyprland window rounding.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 13. Panels: launcher, notification cards, control center.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: 1/φ³ of the tile. App-icon corner.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Reduced motion and plain value changes. Not from the design system: kept from the earlier baseline.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 144. Hover, press, small color changes.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Fibonacci 233, ease-out. Panels, popovers, launcher, workspace moves. Theme switches crossfade the whole desktop in one move; its duration is set during calibration.
